title: Date set for inquest into death of a North Bay man in 2018 following an interaction with police
article: More than four years after the incident, a date has been set for the inquest into the death of Gordon Dale Couvrette, who was killed in North Bay in 2018 at age 43.
Dr. Harry Voogjarv, Regional Supervising Coroner for North Region, Sudbury Office, announced the inquest will begin Nov. 21 in North Bay.
Mr. Couvrette, 43, died in hospital on February 22, 2018, after an interaction with North Bay police officers. An inquest into his death is mandatory under the Coroners Act.
"The inquest will examine the circumstances surrounding Mr. Couvrette's death." said a news release Friday from the province.
"The jury may make recommendations aimed at preventing further deaths."
The inquest is expected to last five days and hear from about 10 witnesses.

The inquest will start at 9 a.m. Nov. 21 at the Best Western Hotel and Conference Centre on Lakeshore Drive in North Bay. Dr. Steven Bodley will be the presiding officer. Jose Rodriguez and Cecilia Martin will be inquest counsel.
